verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents AI-driven test generation from a component's props or reactive state. The Svelte MCP server only supplies documentation and statically analyses generated code (svelte-autofixer), which is adjacent and does not generate tests. Testing support itself is not documented in the pack, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can have AI generate component-level tests based on the props and reactive state my component declares
